description: Pull observations for a cube. Provide one selection per dimension, in the dimension order returned by dataset_dimensions. Each selection is a value label or code, a comma-separated list (e.g. "Males,Females" or "SEX_M,SEX_F"), or the literal "all". The number of selections must equal the cube's dimension count. Output is `rows`: one object per observation with a label for every dimension plus `value` (capped at 2000 rows; `truncated` says so).

selections.description: One entry per dimension, in dataset_dimensions order. Each is a value label or code, a comma-separated list, or "all". Example for as1001rs (5 dimensions): ["Population as of Dec. 31", "Total", "Males,Females", "Persons", "2023,2024"].

name: datacube_sk_get_data
title: Datacube Sk Get Data
